subject: Conditional PO gateway request — MerchantProof pilot
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@merchantproof.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts@merchantproof.com
Date: Sun, 04 Jul 2027 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: MerchantProof pilot — onboarding ask (temporary no-PO for first invoices)

Hi Grace + Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the MerchantProof team is excited to move forward with the 3-month pilot. A quick operational note from our finance side: our billing system issues invoices in batch and we don't always attach a PO on the first two invoices for new pilot customers. To avoid delaying the pilot start, can Redwood consider a temporary invoice-only path (no-PO) for the first three invoices up to $25k total, while we complete your vendor setup?

I've attached our completed onboarding form and the vendor contact for accounts payable. We can provide any additional vendor evidence you need (W9, insurance certificate, payment terms).

Attachments: merchantproof_onboarding_form.pdf (form/fillable), merchantproof_company_profile.pdf (pdf)

Proposed timeline:
- Week 1: Supplier intake + W9 on file
- Week 2: Pilot billing begins; first invoice issued (invoice-only)
- After 3 invoices: transition to standard PO workflow

Let me know if this is feasible and what evidence/procedures you need from us.

Best,
Elena Torres
Head of Partnerships
MerchantProof

---
Elena Torres
MerchantProof | elena@merchantproof.com | +1-415-555-0199
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena@merchantproof.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 04 Jul 2027 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MerchantProof pilot — onboarding ask (temporary no-PO for first invoices)

Thanks Elena — appreciate the heads up and the onboarding form.

Marissa / Priyom: MerchantProof is asking for a short-term exception to the PO mandate for the pilot. Key asks: invoice-only for first three invoices, cap at $25k total. They've attached the onboarding form and said they'll provide W9 + insurance.

Can procurement evaluate and confirm the necessary controls so we can avoid blocking the pilot start? My suggested guardrails to consider:
- Limit temporary no-PO path to three invoices or 30 days, whichever comes first
- Require W9 and COI (insurance) on file before first invoice is processed
- Require invoices to reference the pilot deal ID and match amounts on the signed SOW
- Finance to place a spend alert and flag any invoice > $10k for manual approval

Marissa, can you coordinate with AP to set up a temporary invoice route and confirm what evidence they need? Priyom / David — tagging procurement + commercial ops for risk and approval.

I'll hold off on moving the pilot start date until we have confirmation.

Best,
Grace
Director, Partner Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: merchantproof_onboarding_form.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena@merchantproof.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2027 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MerchantProof pilot — onboarding ask (temporary no-PO for first invoices)

Agree with Grace's suggested guardrails. I've looped in AP intake and they can do a temporary invoice-only routing on a case basis, but procurement needs to sign off on the authority and evidence. AP will require the W9 + signed SOW and the vendor bank details to be on file.

Action items I can own:
- Collect W9 + COI + signed SOW from Elena (Elena, could you share those to accounts@redwood.ai?)
- Slack AP to hold an alert for invoices from MerchantProof with deal tag MP-2027-PILOT-42
- Draft a short temporary exception memo (one-pager) that procurement can approve — I'll prepare and share a draft by EOD.

Priyom — if procurement can confirm authority to approve temporary invoice-only up to $25k and specify any additional evidence (e.g., background check, reference check), please advise. If you want, I can include a proposed termination clause that forces automatic re-enabling of PO mandate after 3 invoices.

Marissa
Commercial Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pilot_budget_evidence.xlsx (budget summary)
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena@merchantproof.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2027 10:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MerchantProof pilot — onboarding ask (temporary no-PO for first invoices)

Thanks everyone — procurement has reviewed the ask and is comfortable with a controlled exception under the following conditions:

1) Term: temporary invoice-only path for up to three invoices OR 45 days from first invoice, whichever comes first.
2) Financial cap: $25,000 cumulative across the three invoices. Any single invoice > $10,000 triggers a secondary approval from David Kim (Finance).
3) Evidence required BEFORE first invoice is processed: W9, Certificate of Insurance (COI), completed onboarding form, signed SOW matching invoice amounts.
4) Controls: AP to tag invoices with deal id MP-2027-PILOT-42 and enable spend alerting; procurement will create an internal exception memo stored in Procure JIRA (PROC-9876).
5) Termination: PO mandate auto-resumes after three invoices or on 45 days; procurement reserves the right to revoke exception with 5 business days notice if any discrepancy is observed.

I approve this conditional exception. Marissa — please produce the one-pager and upload required docs to the shared Drive link. AP: set the invoice route and create the spend flag. Grace: you can confirm pilot start once W9 + COI + SOW are in the shared folder.

I'll add PROC-9876 with the exception memo and link it to this thread.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference

Forwarded-From: Internal procurement checklist template attached: procurement_exception_template.docx
